review.brief: Review tier 2 of RM66 on branch ft/RM66-MAG-59-travel-progress-trends: commits 5e49957, 752a596, 84d67f3. Check: (1) module-boundary compliance - internal/analytics owns its own schema, and the gateway edit in 5e49957 is a rename of call sites, not new coupling; (2) every doc-pack convention, especially the unit-suffix rule and the new _delta_calc naming rule; (3) spec and tasks coverage - all 10 sub-tasks, no acceptance line weakened or deleted, corrections appended only; (4) the database objects match the design the owner confirmed (D-M): 3 ADD COLUMN, 4 RENAME, the comments, and a backfill joining on metric_date - 1 (D-L). A mismatch is a blocker finding; (5) the read-heavy performance profile - the query widening must be projection-only, with no new index and no extra round trip; (6) the test-contract rule - T6's three fixtures and T8's integration case must assert design.md's authored numbers, not whatever the implementation produces; (7) anti-gaming - no self-approved status, no weakened criteria; (8) the delta-guard baseline change in the Makefile, and whether the KB guides now match the code.
